lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the posterior gill slits along the lateral midline, characterized by a decrease in spot density and increase in diameter toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting primary spots to create a rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature on the upper flank showing a high-contrast luminance gradient (bright top edge, dark lower shadow) running parallel to the vertebral axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 distinct high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dense cluster of secondary biological entities (likely remoras) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin; distinct transition from micro-spotting on the cephalic region to macro-spotting on the trunk.
